headline: Sensex surges over 1,000 points as Nifty crosses 25,300 driven by foreign inflows and broad-based buying

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Return of foreign investors pushing stock markets to eight-month high levels
Strong rally in banking and auto sector stocks leading the market surge
Positive opening sentiment adding approximately Rs 4.5 lakh crore in investor wealth
Strong early trade momentum driving the Sensex up by over 1,000 points
whatHappening: Sensex soared over 1,000 points while Nifty 50 traded comfortably above the 25,300 mark
Foreign institutional investors returned as net buyers, boosting overall market sentiment
Gold prices surged by Rs 1,400 while silver jumped by Rs 5,000
Indian airlines expanded premium seat capacity with IndiGo leading the strategic push
summary: Indian stock markets experienced a sharp rally today as foreign investors returned to buy equity shares, driving indices to eight-month highs. Sensex jumped over 1,000 points while Nifty surpassed 25,300, supported strongly by bank and auto stocks. Individual stocks in focus included Orient Green, Tata Power, GRSE, Hindustan Copper, and IndiGo following quarterly updates and strategic announcements.
